# ModernKit v1.5.8 — Heavy Core Is Now a Real Block

The Heavy Core is no longer just an item — it is now a true placeable block, just like in the modern versions.

## 🧱 The Heavy Core Block

- **Placeable** — Craft a Heavy Core with Netherite Ingot surrounded by 4 Obsidian, then place it in the world. It breaks and drops itself like a normal block, with metallic block sounds.
- **The Heavy Core texture on all six faces** — every side of the placed block (four sides, top and bottom) shows the Heavy Core face texture.
- **Crafting unchanged** — the Heavy Core still works exactly as before in the Mace recipe: Heavy Core above a Breeze Rod.
- **Same look in your inventory** — the Heavy Core item keeps its familiar icon in the hotbar and when held.

## 📦 Compatibility

- **Minecraft:** 1.16.5 (Fabric)
- **Requires:** Fabric API and Fabric Loader 0.14.21 (or newer)
- **Works with:** Sodium and Iris — Sodium held-item compatibility is built into the mod
- **Both sides:** install on the client and the server
